extName.message: Packwatch – TCG Restock Alerts & Auto Refresh

extDescription.message: Private restock alerts for trading cards. Watch any shop, get pinged in seconds, never get locked out for refreshing.

cmdToggleRefresh.message: Start or stop Auto refresh on the current tab

welcomeBody.message: Same extension, new focus: alerts the moment an item you care about restocks.

welcomeBullet1.message: Auto refresh still works like before, and your settings moved over. It now can also alert you when a word appears.

welcomeBullet2.message: New: watch a product page and get alerted on restock or preorder.

welcomeBullet3.message: New: watch a shop for new listings that match your keywords.

alertQueueBody.message: Don't refresh, you'll lose your place. Packwatch stopped checking.

alertChallengeBody.message: Open the page and continue there yourself. Packwatch stopped checking.

alertTestBody.message: This is what a restock alert looks like.

backingOff.message: Backing off: the site is rate-limiting. Checks will speed up again after a good response.

chooseActiveBanner.message: Your Pro access ended. Choose which 3 monitors stay active.

disclaimer.message: Packwatch is independent and not affiliated with any game publisher or retailer.

emptyMonitors.message: No monitors yet. Open a product or shop page and click Watch in the Packwatch popup.

errDenied.message: Packwatch needs permission to check $1. Try again and click Allow.

errLimit.message: The Free plan watches up to 3 pages at once.

keywordsIncludePh.message: e.g. OP-15, booster box, elite trainer

lessReliable.message: Less reliable: no product data found, using the page's buttons. Picking the stock button is more accurate.

noProductsFound.message: No products found on this page.

nudgeBody.message: Pro would have pinged your phone.

nudgeListing.message: $1 was listed at $2 while you were away.

nudgePreorder.message: $1 opened for preorder at $2 while you were away.

nudgeRestock.message: $1 restocked at $2 while you were away.

openShopPage.message: Open a product or shop page, then click Packwatch to watch it.

pickerHint.message: Click the button that shows stock (Add to cart / Sold out).

priceGuard.message: Only alert restocks at or below my price

proDiscord.message: Discord alerts to your own server

proFast.message: Checks every 15 seconds (polite limits still apply)

proHistory.message: Full restock history, patterns and CSV export

proPhone.message: Phone alerts via the free ntfy app

proPrice.message: Price alerts, price guard and seller filter

queueNote.message: Waiting room or bot check: Packwatch stopped reloading so you keep your place. Resume when you're done.

staleRow.message: Not checked for a while. Check the shop is reachable, or edit the monitor.

tabModeNote.message: This page needs a browser tab to render. Packwatch opened a small pinned tab for it.

upgradeError.message: Couldn't open the payment page. Check your connection and try again.

upgradeSub.message: $1-day free trial, cancel anytime. Everything in Free, plus:

watchingListings.message: Watching this page for new listings

simpleQueue.message: Waiting room detected: refreshing stopped so you keep your place.

simpleTypingNote.message: Waits while you type or have unsaved form input.

simpleIntro.message: Refresh this tab automatically. Tap an interval to start.

optHardTip.message: Skip the browser cache on every refresh

optScrollTip.message: Return to the same spot after each refresh

autoOpen.message: Open the product tab automatically on restock (focuses it if already open)

statsNote.message: Counted on this device only. Packwatch never sends them anywhere.

chooseBody.message: Your Pro access ended. Everything is kept: the rest are paused and come back if you upgrade.

planIsPro.message: You're on Packwatch Pro. Thank you!

planIsFree.message: You're on the Free plan: 3 monitors, checks every 60 seconds.

phoneIntro.message: Get restock alerts on your phone with the free ntfy app. No account and no Packwatch server: alerts go straight from your browser to ntfy.

phoneStep1.message: Install the free ntfy app (Android or iPhone).

phoneStep2.message: Scan this code, or tap + in the app and subscribe to the topic below.

stallToPhone.message: Also send “monitor stopped” alerts to my phone and Discord

phonePrivacy.message: Your topic is random and private. Anyone who learns it could read your alerts, so don't share it.

discordIntro.message: Post alerts to your own private server. In Discord: Server settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New webhook → Copy URL.

discordInvalid.message: That doesn't look like a Discord webhook URL.

discordSaved.message: Saved. A test alert was sent to your channel.

quietIntro.message: During quiet hours alerts are silent and nothing goes to your phone or Discord, except monitors set to “Wake me”.

patternsEmpty.message: Patterns appear once a shop has 3 or more restocks logged.

historyEmpty.message: No events yet. Restocks, preorders and new listings will show up here.

packsIntro.message: Share a set of monitors, e.g. “watchlist for the new set”. Packs contain pages and keywords only: never your history, settings or alert channels.

packPastePh.message: …or paste a pack here (packwatch:… or JSON)

packDenied.message: Packwatch needs permission for these shops to import the pack.

packResult.message: Imported $1, skipped $2 (already watching, or over your plan's limit).

packExport.message: Export your monitors as a pack

packExportNote.message: $1 monitors will be included, without any personal data.

doneProduct.message: You'll get an alert the moment it restocks or opens for preorder.

doneListing.message: You'll get an alert when a matching new product is listed.

cantReadStock.message: Packwatch can't read stock here automatically

lessReliableShort.message: Read from the page's buttons. If it looks wrong, point at the stock button under More options.

unreadableHelp.message: Show Packwatch which button says “Add to cart” or “Sold out”, and it will watch that.

switchToListings.message: Watch this shop for new listings instead
